title: 模态差异Transformer用于矛盾与犹豫识别
summary: 本文提出模态差异Transformer（MDT），基于冲突感知多模态融合框架，将6-token设计扩展为9-token表示，包含模态嵌入、绝对差特征和Hadamard积差异特征，通过Transformer自注意力、FiLM文本条件调制和LoRA微调实现。在BAH数据集上Macro F1达0.7408，超越最强基线超10个点，单GPU训练不到20分钟。
summary_en: This paper presents the Modality Discrepancy Transformer (MDT), built on a conflict-aware multimodal fusion framework. It extends the original 6-token design to a 9-token representation with modality embeddings, absolute-difference features, and Hadamard-product discrepancy features, processed via Transformer self-attention with FiLM-based text-conditioned modulation and LoRA fine-tuning. MDT achieves 0.7408 Macro F1 on the BAH dataset, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 10 points while training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU.
